description: This file implements the RoomMaintainer class, which manages chat rooms and user participation in those rooms. It handles creating rooms, adding users, removing users, notifying observers about room events, and sending messages within rooms.

classes.name: RoomMaintainer
classes.description: Manages chat rooms and user memberships, providing methods to join and leave rooms, notify users, send messages, and manage observers.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Allows a user to join a specified room; creates the room if it does not exist, and adds the user to the room.

methods.name: Exit
methods.description: Removes a user from a room; destroys the room if it becomes empty.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Notifies all users in a room about a new user joining.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a message from a user to all other users in the same room.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink to receive room event notifications.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification sink.
